summary.result: Climate change scenarios showed that the overall evapotranspiration in the 2085s reduced from 10.5 % to 16.3 %.
summary.background: The global rise in atmospheric $CO_2$ concentration and its associated climate change have significant effects on agricultural productivity and hydrological cycle.
summary.method: APEX-Paddy model, which is the modified version of APEX (Agricultural Policy/Environmental eXtender) model for paddy ecosystem, was used to evaluate rice productivity and evapotranspiration based on climate change scenario.

summary_ko.method: 논생태계를 대상으로 개발된 APEX-Paddy 모델은 기후변화 시나리오에 기반하여 벼 생산성과 증발산을 평가하기 위해 사용되었다.
summary_ko.result: 기후변화 시나리오에 따르면 2085년대의 전체 증발산은 10.5%에서 16.3%로 감소하였다.
